text:
Anita P.: quick heads-up — found a repro where tenant header injection runs before path normalization for wildcard routes, which lets a crafted path escape tenant mapping.
Raj K.: ugh. can you paste the route config that triggers it?
Anita P.:
```
match: /v1/*
rewrite:
  inject_headers:
    x-tenant: "{{path.segment(2)}}"
  path_normalize: false
```
Sam L.: ok that explains it. we expected normalizer -> inject, but runtime is doing inject -> normalize for wildcard matchers.
Toni M.: what's the risk surface?
Anita P.: some clients can send `/v1/../other/` and if header templating pulls segments before normalize, it can set x-tenant to an unintended value. data isolation concern for multi-tenant routes.
DevOps Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-093 — labeling as P1 :warning:
Raj K.: quick mitigation idea: make template evaluation happen after normalization when templates reference path/query. not the default for all rewrites to avoid perf regression.
Anita P.: prototype config option: `evaluate_templates_after_normalize` — example: 
```
rewrite:
  inject_headers:
    x-tenant: "{{path.segment(1)}}"
  evaluate_templates_after_normalize: true
  path_normalize: true
```
Sam L.: i like the granular flag. we should also add a header whitelist so only approved headers can be injected (x-tenant, x-routing-meta).
Raj K.: agreed. propose: default behavior = current (templates evaluated early) but if `evaluate_templates_after_normalize: true` then runtime will normalize path/query first, then evaluate templates and inject headers. patch will only change evaluation order for rules that opt-in.
Toni M.: also note query canonicalization interaction — if the template references raw query keys, normalization that reorders or dedupes params will change evaluation. need tests for query-case.
Anita P.: example repro curl i used: `curl -v "https://gw.internal/v1/../acct/1?b=2&a=1" -H "x-overrides: tenant=acct1"` — with current behavior header becomes acct from raw segment, not normalized path.
Sam L.: action items: 1) Raj to draft gateway change + unit/integration tests (include ../ paths + query reorder). 2) Anita to add repro harness + test vectors. 3) Sam to update docs and console UX notes (show rule uses evaluate_templates_after_normalize). 4) Toni to own rollout plan (staged flag for hosted vs dedicated).
Raj K.: will add header_whitelist option to the rewrite schema too: `header_whitelist: ["x-tenant", "x-routing-meta"]` so unexpected headers can be rejected at config validation time.
DevOps Bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/gateway/pull/1789 by Raj K. — CI passed :white_check_mark:
Anita P.: thanks — i'll validate in staging once PR lands. also let's add a small note in the runbook about detecting suspicious "../" patterns combined with header overrides.
Sam L.: good call. console UX: show a warning badge on rules that inject templates and also have path_normalize=false; link to docs. i can mock the UX copy.
Toni M.: timeline?
Raj K.: aiming to have PR + tests by EOD tomorrow, rollout flag + docs the following week.
Anita P.: tagging @Raj K. and @Sam L. for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
